controls.label: Categories
controls.description: List of product categories.

controls.label: Show current category ancestors
controls.description: If you visit category Man, for example, only man's subcategories will be shown in the page title like T-shirts, Coats, Shoes etc.

controls.label: Show category neighbors if there is no children
controls.description: If the category you visit doesn't contain any subcategories, the page title menu will display this category's neighbors categories.

controls.label: Hide empty
controls.description: Don’t display categories that don’t have any products assigned.

controls.label: Layout
controls.description: Try out our creative styles for categories block.

controls.label: Columns
controls.description: Number of columns in the grid.

controls.label: Grid items with different sizes
controls.description: Specify certain grid items to be doubled in size. Example: “1,3,5”.

controls.label: Items per page
controls.description: Enter the number of categories to display for this element.

controls.label: Slides per view
controls.description: Set numbers of slides you want to display at the same time on slider's container for carousel mode.

controls.label: Scroll per page
controls.description: Scroll per page not per item. This affect next/prev buttons and mouse/touch dragging.

controls.label: Slider speed
controls.description: Duration of animation between slides (in ms)

controls.label: Init carousel on scroll
controls.description: This option allows you to init carousel script only when visitor scroll the page to the slider. Useful for performance optimization.

controls.label: Hide prev/next buttons
controls.description: If "YES" prev/next control will be removed

controls.label: Hide pagination control
controls.description: If "YES" pagination control will be removed.

controls.label: Hide scrollbar
controls.description: If "YES" scrollbar will be removed.

controls.label: Synchronization
controls.description: Links carousels to navigate together. Use Parent/Child mode to pair two carousels, or Equal group mode to synchronize multiple carousels.

controls.label: ID
controls.description: Copy this ID and paste it into the "ID" field of the child carousel.

controls.label: ID
controls.description: Copy the ID from the parent carousel and paste it into this field.

controls.label: ID
controls.description: All carousels with the same ID will be synchronized. Use different IDs for different groups.

controls.label: Categories design
controls.description: Overrides option from Theme Settings -> Shop

controls.label: Image dimension
controls.description: You can crop the original image size to any custom size. You can also set a single value for height or width in order to keep the original size ratio.

controls.label: Bordered grid
controls.description: Add borders between the categories in your grid.

controls.label: Categories background
controls.description: Add a background to the categories in your grid.
